title: British Trifle with Nectarine
description: A classic British dessert featuring layers of sponge cake, fruit, custard, and whipped cream.
instructions: 1. In a large serving dish, create a layer of sponge cake.
2. Top the cake layer with sliced nectarines and fresh raspberries.
3. In a separate bowl, whip the heavy cream until stiff peaks form.
4. Spread the whipped cream over the fruit layer.
5. In another bowl, mix the vanilla custard with granulated sugar until well combined.
6. Pour the custard mixture over the whipped cream layer.
7. Repeat the layers, starting with the sponge cake, then the fruit, whipped cream, and finally the custard.
8. Top the trifle with a dollop of whipped cream and a sprinkle of granulated sugar.
9. Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
